name: drizzle-e2e-mysql
description: Baked dependency set for the mysql drizzle-e2e lane. The packages UNDER TEST (@mionjs/drizzle-orm*, @mionjs/bin-compiler) are NOT here: each run installs them from the in-container verdaccio. dockerode, get-port and dotenv are load-bearing no-ops — mysql-common.ts imports them at the top level for a docker helper the lane never reaches, because it sets MYSQL_CONNECTION_STRING instead.
